threats.title: Faking Login Credentials
threats.description: A Malicious user gains the login credentials of a different user through social engineering or exploiting a vulnerability in the user information store.
threats.mitigation: Secure Data store with industry level security and implement two-factor authentication.

threats.title: User Obtains Confidential Information
threats.description: User exposes confidential information through the interface
threats.mitigation: Limit and encrypt all information that is sent to the UI

threats.title: User Actions not Being Logged
threats.description: user actions such as trying to modify or delete user data are not logged
threats.mitigation: Ensure verbose logging system that holds logs in multiple places with fail safes

threats.title: UI goes down
threats.description: UI becomes unavailable due to overload of requests or unforeseen circumstances
threats.mitigation: Ensure backup servers are available and fail safes are in place.

threats.title: User accesses maintenance personnel abilities
threats.description: Malicious user exploits a vulnerability to trick system into thinking they are a maintenance personnel to get free rides and modify vehicles.
threats.mitigation: Safeguard all maintenance personnel roles and check multiple times if user credentials match a maintenance personnel's

threats.title: Vehicle Information is altered
threats.description: Vehicle information such as location, gas levels, etc is altered
threats.mitigation: Cross check with local offline backup and log all actions taken on store

threats.title: User using payment information that is not their own
threats.description: User enabling themselves to use another persons payment information via account spoofing, vulnerability in database, or vulnerability in processing
threats.mitigation: Check all information coming from account database and safe guard other users information in payment processing

threats.title: Tampering of system
threats.description: Malicious user breaks in or exploits a vulnerability to alter system and change payment logic
threats.mitigation: Ensure tight monitoring of payment processing.

threats.title: Payment Processing goes down
threats.description: Payment processing becomes unavailable due to overload of requests or unforeseen circumstances
threats.mitigation: Ensure backup servers are available and fail safes are in place.

threats.title: User information is altered
threats.description: User information is altered externally to change role
threats.mitigation: Cross check with local offline backup and log all actions taken on store

threats.title: User is exposed to confidential information
threats.description: Malicious user accesses database from outside to get information on other users
threats.mitigation: Ensure data is encrypted and monitor access

threats.title: Route Planning goes down
threats.description: Route planning becomes unavailable due to overload of requests or unforeseen circumstances
threats.mitigation: Ensure backup servers are available and fail safes are in place.

threats.title: Fake Onboard System
threats.description: Onboard system is replaced with a malicious program.
threats.mitigation: Ensure all vehicles are scanned prior to being used and monitor direct infiltrations of the system

threats.title: Modification of onboard system
threats.description: Malicious user uploads own program or tampers with onboard system
threats.mitigation: Monitor system to ensure intruder is caught. Include fail safe to shut down vehicle if detected interference

threats.title: Onboard system goes down
threats.description: Onboard system becomes unusable and ceases to provide any updates, maps, or driving proficiency
threats.mitigation: Ensure fail safe to safe stop the car is in place and alert controller
